verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a real outbound HTTP callback: you pass webhook_url when starting a run, and Skyvern sends one POST to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status. That is a per-run completion callback rather than a general event subscription. The Zapier connector does not count as a registrable webhook. Missing for 10: account- or org-level webhook registration covering multiple event types (e.g. step progress, human-in-the-loop pauses), documented payload schema, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
